# proxcenter_storages (Data Source)

Storages of a connection; a vDC tenant sees its vDC storages only. Needs storage:read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxcenter_storages" "prod" {
  connection_id = data.proxcenter_vdc.prod.connection_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String) Cluster connection.

### Read-Only

- `storages` (Attributes List) The storages, shared ones first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storages))

<a id="nestedatt--storages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storages`

Read-Only:

- `content` (List of String) Content types it accepts, e.g. images.
- `free` (Number) Bytes.
- `nodes` (List of String) Nodes that mount it.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether every node listed mounts the same storage.
- `storage` (String) Storage name, the storage of a disk block.
- `total` (Number) Bytes.
- `type` (String) Proxmox storage type, e.g. rbd, lvmthin.
